title: What Vestail provides
body: Vestail is operated by [LEGAL ENTITY NAME], [ADDRESS]. These terms cover our site, app and API. By using them you agree to these terms.

title: Eligibility information
body: Verdicts are eligible, conditional, restricted or unverified. They explain published ownership conditions. This is disclosure, not legal, tax or investment advice, a compliance guarantee or permission from a regulator. Get independent advice when needed.

title: Your declarations
body: Country, region and residency are self-declared. Vestail does not perform KYC. You must provide accurate information and follow the laws that apply to you.

title: Your wallet and transactions
body: Vestail is non-custodial. You approve and sign transactions with your own wallet. Vestail never holds your funds or private keys. Swaps and purchases route through third parties, including Jupiter and issuers; their fees, risks and terms apply.

title: Rules and sources
body: Rules come from issuer and other published sources and may be incomplete or outdated. Unverified means the relevant rule has not yet been sourced; it does not mean eligible. Read the source and conditions before acting.

title: Prices
body: Displayed stock-token prices track the most liquid Solana token representation available to the app. They can differ from the underlying share price and your execution price.

title: API use
body: Keep API keys confidential and on your server. Observe rate limits. Do not resell raw Vestail data. We may suspend abusive or compromised keys, including keys used to evade limits or disrupt service.

title: Prohibited use
body: Do not misuse accounts, scrape to resell raw data, bypass access controls, interfere with systems, impersonate others or use Vestail for unlawful activity. We may restrict access to protect the service.

title: Third-party services
body: Links and routes do not mean we endorse a venue or issuer. Check their eligibility restrictions, terms and privacy notices. Networks, wallets and external services can fail or change.

title: Warranties and liability
body: The service is provided as available without promises of accuracy, availability or fitness for your purpose. To the extent permitted by applicable law, [LEGAL ENTITY NAME] is not liable for indirect losses, lost profits or losses from reliance on information or third-party transactions. Nothing excludes rights or liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.
